facility.name: ABC Lighthouse Childcare Center
facility.programs_provided: School Age Care,Before School Care,Accredited,Meals Provided ,After School Care,Snacks Provided,Part Time Care,Transportation to/from School ,Field Trips

provenance.note: Census Geocoder Non_Exact match: 19005 FM 529, CYPRESS, TX, 77433

inspection_summary.note: Texas HHSC inspections, report investigations and assessments since October 2017, updated daily.

occurrences.finding: Responsibilities of Caregivers - Know children's names and ages: Documentation showing the children's ages was not made available upon request during the inspection.    Note: The provider printed a list with the names and ages of children in care during the inspection.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Responsibilities of Caregivers - Know children's names and ages (26 TAC §746.1205(a)(3))

occurrences.finding: Safety - Areas Free From Hazards: During the inspection, an ant bed was observed on the playground.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Safety - Areas Free From Hazards (26 TAC §746.3701)

occurrences.finding: Responsibilities of Caregivers - Know number of children responsible for: A caregiver did not know the correct number of children they were responsible for during the inspection.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Responsibilities of Caregivers - Know number of children responsible for (26 TAC §746.1205(a)(2))

occurrences.finding: Maintenance of Building, Grounds and Equipment: In two of the restroom the sink is detaching from the wall were it could fall on a child. The tarp on the play structure is torn.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Maintenance of Building, Grounds and Equipment (26 TAC §746.3407)

occurrences.finding: Requirements for Feeding Infants - Never Prop Bottles: An five month old infant bottle was prop doing feeding when the CCR inspector walked into the classroom.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Requirements for Feeding Infants - Never Prop Bottles (26 TAC §746.2419(3))

occurrences.finding: Children's Products- Review list and Remove unsafe products: The operation did not have an Consumer Product Safety Commission (CPSC) form for viewing.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Children's Products- Review list and Remove unsafe products (26 TAC §746.4135(a))

occurrences.finding: Maintenance Procedures for Active Play - Monthly Maintenance Checklist: The operation did not have documentation of them conduct a monthly inspections of the playground.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Maintenance Procedures for Active Play - Monthly Maintenance Checklist (26 TAC §746.4751(b))

occurrences.finding: Sheltering Drills for Lock-Down-4 times in a calendar year: The operation has not practiced lock down drills.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Sheltering Drills for Lock-Down-4 times in a calendar year (26 TAC §746.5205(3))

occurrences.finding: Fire Drill Monthly - Exit in 3 Minutes: The operation has not practiced a monthly fire drill.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Fire Drill Monthly - Exit in 3 Minutes (26 TAC §746.5205(1))

occurrences.finding: Sheltering Drill For Severe Weather-Four times a calendar year: The operation has not practiced sheltering/severe weather drill.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Sheltering Drill For Severe Weather-Four times a calendar year (26 TAC §746.5205(2))

occurrences.finding: Children's Records - Health Statement: Two children's files do not have a signed health statement from a health care professional.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Children's Records - Health Statement (26 TAC §746.603(a)(3))

occurrences.finding: Annual Fire Inspection - Before Initial Permit Issued and Every 12 Months: During the inspection the fire inspection report provided was from 2021 and not the most recent inspection report.    Note: During the inspection the most recent report was not available for review.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Annual Fire Inspection - Before Initial Permit Issued and Every 12 Months (26 TAC §746.5101(a))

occurrences.finding: Garbage Inaccessible to Children; Maintained in Sanitary Manner: During the inspection garbage/trash can was accessible to children in care.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Garbage Inaccessible to Children; Maintained in Sanitary Manner (26 TAC §746.3407(8))

occurrences.finding: Director's Absence -  Employees Know Who Is in Charge: During the inspection  caregivers did not who was in charge in the absence of the primary and second director. During the inspection other caregivers gave different names of who was in charge.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Director's Absence -  Employees Know Who Is in Charge (26 TAC §746.1013(c))

occurrences.finding: Basic Requirements for Infants - Never Unsupervised: During the inpsection the caregiver left two infants unspervised to answer to front door.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Basic Requirements for Infants - Never Unsupervised (26 TAC §746.2401(7))

occurrences.finding: Types of Vehicles Used to Transport Children - Be Maintained Safely: During the inspection a stray cat was found in a vehicle used to transport children.      Note: The doors were opened by the second director and the cat ran out.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Types of Vehicles Used to Transport Children - Be Maintained Safely (26 TAC §746.5603(c))

occurrences.finding: Required Admission Information - Emergency Medical Authorization: During the inspection, two infants files were incomplete and missing the required emergency information.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Admission Information - Special Needs Statement (26 TAC §746.605(12))

occurrences.finding: Diaper Changing Equipment - No Play or Eating Surfaces Used: During the inspection, I observed changing equipment/pad on a table used by children in care.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Diaper Changing Equipment - No Play or Eating Surfaces Used (26 TAC §746.3503(b))

occurrences.finding: Animals - Do Not Create Unsafe or Unsanitary Conditions: During the inspection the operation failed at creating a safe and sanitary condition for children in care as it pertained to an animal.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Animals - Do Not Create Unsafe or Unsanitary Conditions (26 TAC §746.3901(2))

occurrences.finding: Covering Infant's Head or Crib: During the inspection an infant was found with a blanket over their head, the infant was completely covered in the restrictive device.       Note: The regulatory inspector removed the blanket from the infants head and body and  informed the Designee by phone.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Covering Infant's Head or Crib (26 TAC §746.2429)

occurrences.finding: Annual Fire Inspection - Before Initial Permit Issued and Every 12 Months: During the inspection the fire inspection report provided was from 2021 and not the most recent inspection report.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Annual Fire Inspection - Before Initial Permit Issued and Every 12 Months (26 TAC §746.5101(a))

occurrences.finding: Safety - Areas Free From Hazards: During the inspection, I observed a phone charger cord accessible to children in care. I also observed on the playground two metal poles accessible to children in care.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Safety - Areas Free From Hazards (26 TAC §746.3701)

occurrences.finding: Infant May Not Sleep in a Restrictive Device: During the inspection an infant was found sleeping in a restrictive device.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Infant May Not Sleep in a Restrictive Device (26 TAC §746.2426(a)(1))

occurrences.finding: Infants sleep in Designated Crib, Cot, Bed, or Mat: During the inpsection infants were not in the desginated crib.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Infants sleep in Designated Crib, Cot, Bed, or Mat (26 TAC §746.2424)

occurrences.finding: Planned Activities Designed to Meet Individual Needs: When asked during the inspection, caregivers did not provide licensing with an activity plan.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Planned Activities Designed to Meet Individual Needs (26 TAC §746.2201)

occurrences.finding: Infant Care Area - Safe, Open Floor Space: I observed the infant classroom floor space filled with items/objects the director mentioned were used as floating items/objects. Items included travel shelves, cots, and bowling balls and pins.       Note: The area was cleared of all hazards before the inspection concluded.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Infant Care Area - Safe, Open Floor Space (26 TAC §746.2403(2))

occurrences.finding: Children Not Allowed in Areas with Pesticide Residue: I observed a rodent bait trap accessible to children in care.      The rodent bait traps were removed and were inaccessibe to children.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Children Not Allowed in Areas with Pesticide Residue (26 TAC §746.3429(a))

occurrences.finding: Personal use of electronic devices, such as cell phones, MP3 players, tablets, and video games: I observed a caregiver on a personal device while at the operation during the inspection.    The caregiver removed the device during the inspection.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Personal use of electronic devices, such as cell phones, MP3 players, tablets, and video games (26 TAC §746.1203(3)(D))

occurrences.finding: Diaper Changing Steps- Prompt: I observed a seven month old diaper full who had not been changed promptly.       The caregiver was instructed to change the infants diaper.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Diaper Changing Steps- Prompt (26 TAC §746.3501(1))

occurrences.finding: Safety Requirements for Sprinkler Play - Equipment and Water Hoses Kept Out of Child's Reach: I observed a water hose accessible to children, near the door that leads to the playground.      Note: The water hose was put away during the inspection.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Safety Requirements for Sprinkler Play - Equipment and Water Hoses Kept Out of Child's Reach (26 TAC §746.5015(c))

occurrences.finding: Screen Time Activities - Not Used for Under Two: I observed four infants in care under the age of two years old engaging in screen time during the inspection.    Infants were relocated to the infant room.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Screen Time Activities - Not Used for Under Two (26 TAC §746.2207(a))

occurrences.finding: Basic Requirements for Infants - Holding and Comforting: I observed an infant upset and crying while caregivers were on personal devices.       Note: The caregiver put away all personal devices and immediately attended to the infant when instructed.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Basic Requirements for Infants - Holding and Comforting (26 TAC §746.2401(3))

occurrences.finding: Children's Products- Annual Certification: The operation has not update their children  product certification since 2020.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Children's Products- Annual Certification (26 TAC §746.4135(b))

occurrences.finding: Electronic or Battery-Operated Carbon Monoxide Detector-Document Test Date, Battery Installation Date, and Staff Name Testing and Installation: The operation has not documented their monthly carbon monoxide device for 2021.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Electronic or Battery-Operated Carbon Monoxide Detector-Document Test Date, Battery Installation Date, and Staff Name Testing and Installation (26 TAC §746.5537(a)(3))

occurrences.finding: Fire Drill Monthly - Exit in 3 Minutes: The operation has not done their annual fire drill for 2021.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Fire Drill Monthly - Exit in 3 Minutes (26 TAC §746.5205(1))

occurrences.finding: Sheltering Drill For Severe Weather-Four times a calendar year: The operation has not done their annual weather drill for 2021.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Sheltering Drill For Severe Weather-Four times a calendar year (26 TAC §746.5205(2))

occurrences.finding: Inspect Fire Extinguishers Monthly: The operation has not documented their monthly fire extinguisher inspection for 2021.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Inspect Fire Extinguishers Monthly (26 TAC §746.5307(a))

occurrences.finding: Sheltering Drills for Lock-Down-4 times in a calendar year: The operation has not done their annual lock down drill for 2021.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Sheltering Drills for Lock-Down-4 times in a calendar year (26 TAC §746.5205(3))
